description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a larger white blocky chair-like piece on the right and a smaller white connector piece lying near the center. The right hand moves in from the right to touch the larger piece, then both hands grasp it as a two-hand object and adjust it slightly upright; the right hand releases while the left hand steadies it, and finally the right hand reaches down and picks up another small connector piece as a right-hand object.
